Can’t believe there are still ppl who think crochet clothes look ugly when I think they’re some of the most beautiful pieces ever 😤 The fact that they can’t be made by machines makes each crochet piece feel so much more soulful and special! 🥹 If you’re trying to level up ur crochet game, here are some of my tips: 1. Opt for smaller yarn sizes! I started with size 4 Aran yarn, and now I literally never touch anything thicker than DK 🫢 Thicker yarn creates bulkier pieces! 2. Experiment with different fibers & ditch those milk cotton yarns 😩 Not trying to be a hater, but my milk cotton clothes are all too hot and stiff 🫠 Try plant-fiber yarns for a more airy result, or acrylic blends for something lighter! 3. Practice, practice, practice! Tension and hook choices matter too, so keep experimenting until you find what works for you~ What do you think? Do you also think crochet clothes look ugly? 🤔 Patterns featured: YVONNE, LUNA & HUĀ by me! 🤍 Use code YVONNE25 for 25% off all patterns until August 16! 🔥 I’ve completed my second prototype of a fan-laced crochet corset. This time, I incorporated synthetic whalebone as a type of corset boning, which is better than the spiral steel boning I used in my first version. It looks more structured than my initial attempt. The boning is securely stitched underneath the corset using a boning tunnel/casing. I used a sturdy wax cord that can withstand pulling for the lacing. I paired it with my freehand crocheted bustier top. This corset is for aesthetic purposes only and is a statement piece in your wardrobe. It will not function as a traditional corset because it is a crocheted version with added structure.  The crochet pattern will be available for purchase soon! It is currently in the testing phase. Learn the Even Moss Stitch An easy crochet stitch with a simple 2-row repeat that works up quickly and creates a beautiful textured fabric. This beginner friendly crochet stitch uses just slip stitches and half double crochet (US) / half treble crochet (UK), making it easy to learn and remember. Perfect for blankets, scarves, dishcloths and lots of other crochet projects. Follow along with my step-by-step Even Moss Stitch crochet tutorial, with both US and UK crochet terms included. #crochettutorial #crochetstitch #evenmossstitch #crochetforbeginners #purlnhook
